title: NSCLC spatial discordance fixed-coefficient transport audit
description: Aggregate, deidentified reproducibility archive for a prespecified secondary reanalysis of public multicenter NSCLC spatial transcriptomic data. Yale supplied fixed coefficients, Greek was the sole confirmatory held-out center within the parent study, and UQ was a descriptive stress test after a prespecified sample-size gate failed.
